description: Ordered steps of the composition of a view page: creating the composition of its declared regions and overlays, the document calls of a document region, the region state, onState and history values, the region refusals, and the disposal. The view page is sok://probe/ with the element rectangles of the elements field, and the viewport is 800 by 600 CSS pixels. A step is one of create (composition.create over the named elements), do (a call of the composition or of a region of the composition), listen (a region listener, named listener: onState by default, onMessage with kind message), event (a host document-state event, a document-message event with message, or a document-stream message with handle), or close (the close of the stream subscription at index subscription). A do step whose args contain listener:<name> passes a listener that records each message under that name. answers are the host answers to the calls that the step posts, in the order of the posted calls; each answer is {result} or {error: {code, message}}, and noop in args is a change function that changes nothing. Each step lists what it produces: posted is the messages the page posted during the step in order, delivered is the listener calls in order as {listener, state}, settled tells whether the call finished, result is the value of the call (create gives the kind of the composition, and a region gives its name), throws is the text of the error or null, state is the state of region doc after the step or null without a composition, and history is the history value of region doc or null before its attach reply.
